jurisdictions_federation.a_box_s_role_is: Doorka sanduuqu waa xawaaraha uu dejiyay — mid kasta oo loo aqoonsaday, la codsaday, la ansixiyay, lana galay si madax-bannaan. Xawaarahada is-sheegay waa doorashada kaabayaasha ee hawlgaliyaha; xawaarahaha maamulan waxay maraan ogolaanshaha laba-cabka ee shabakadda (guddiga maamulka ee hawlgaliyaha, ama dawlad kursi haysa).
jurisdictions_federation.adopt_this_inst: Ku dar tusaalahan cluster jira si uu u noqdo nuqul muraayad ah oo kaliya oo akhris ah oo diiwaannada dadweyne ah — waxba kama amar qaado. Haddii uu leeyahay fure ku biirid, isla markiiba waa la aqbalayaa; haddii kale, codsiga waxaa lagu ridaa safka si hawlgaliyaha martida ah uu u xaqiijiyo.
jurisdictions_federation.approving_an_ad: Ansixinta ku biirista waxay ogolaanaysaa nuqul muraayad ah oo akhris kaliya ah (waxba kama amar qaado). Akhris-qoraalku waa oggolaansho maamulan oo gooni ah — waxa go'aamiya dawladda taagan ee xuduud awoodeedka (Art. V §7) ama, haddii aysan jirin, guddiga maamulka ee hawlgaliyaha ee jira — ee ma aha gujis konsool.

jurisdictions_federation.to_run_the_dns_: Si aad u maamusho doorka dilaalka DNS/TLS, geli token-ka DNS-edit ee Cloudflare ee domain kasta oo aad dilaal ka noqonayso.
